description: Use this for date-specific pet questions at a visible Total Parks-listed property. Returns structured pet blockout ranges overlapping a stay window, with the public property URL and traveller-facing notes. Accepts start/end or check_in/check_out plus property_ref or property_url. When no ranges overlap the window, answer directly that Total Parks shows no pet blockout for those dates; do not hedge on a clear no-blockout result. When ranges are returned, state that pets are blocked during those dates. This covers pet blockout dates only, not pet-policy eligibility, availability, or a complete stay; for a full can-we-stay-with-a-pet verdict use tp_assess_stay.

check_in.description: Stay check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pair with check_out. Example: '2026-10-03'.

check_out.description: Stay check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after check_in. Example: '2026-10-06'.

end.description: Last date of the stay window to check for pet blockouts (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after start. Alias: check_out. Example: '2026-04-07'.

property_id.description: Internal property ID. Compatibility only; prefer property_ref or property_url from a previous Total Parks tool result.

property_ref.description: Public property ref from tp_resolve_property or search, formatted as '{state}/{slug}'. Prefer this or property_url over internal IDs. Example: 'victoria/big4-aireys-inlet'.

property_url.description: Traveller-facing Total Parks property URL returned by a previous tool. Accepted as an alias of property_ref. Example: 'https://totalparks.com.au/victoria/big4-aireys-inlet'.

start.description: First date of the stay window to check for pet blockouts (YYYY-MM-DD). Alias: check_in. Example: '2026-04-03'.

name: tp_get_pet_blockouts

items.description: A concrete blocked date range resolved for a specific year.

label.description: Display label for UI and booking rejections

preset_key.description: Preset key when source == 'preset', otherwise null

title: Get pet blockouts
